ai_summary.key_headline: El Tri's Flank Attacks Collide with Son's Speed in High-Octane Clash

mexico.philosophy: High-possession positional play with inverted wingers and overlapping fullbacks.

south_korea.philosophy: Highly disciplined mid-block with rapid direct counter-attacking transitions.

tactical_insights: Edson Alvarez will anchor Aguirre's midfield, screening against South Korea's direct central counters.
Captain Son Heung-min's inside runs from the left will target Mexico's right fullback in transition.
Raul Jimenez's hold-up play will be key for El Tri to sustain pressure on the Korean back line.
